dedupe_keys.name: bangladesh transmission grid 1 year master substation peak load and temporal profile database 60k records

description: Shisir Al Mazid, M. I. Raiyan Bin Rafik and Abdul Muttalib compile daily peak-load observations for 249 transmission substations across Bangladesh's eight administrative divisions. Their Excel workbook records date, harmonised station name, maximum load in megawatts and the time of that maximum. The description states 60,626 observations from 1 January to 30 December 2025, but also calls this a 365-day period; that inconsistency remains unresolved. The September 2026 release is free under CC BY 4.0 and digitises National Load Despatch Centre logs. The reported row count does not establish a complete station-by-day panel. These local peaks can inform substation-capacity and seasonal load scenarios, but maxima at different times cannot be summed as coincident system demand. Related catalogue records cover the authors' national and plant-level databases and a separate hourly dispatch collection. The substation workbook itself was not downloaded.
